fields.Name: T104 - Knowledge Hub Duplicates
fields.Description: Opens the Knowledge Hub Duplicates screen once, then exercises the semantic duplicate-detection run and the record-comparison slide-in panel in one run, verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T257, T258.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, then click 'Duplicates' in the left nav (fa-clone icon). Then perform these sub-actions IN ORDER, and as you complete each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) duplicate-detection-run — in the top-right header open the 'Select entity document…' dropdown and pick an entity document, then click the 'Run Detection' button, and confirm detection starts (a progress section with a stage label and percent appears) and afterward the KPI strip (Total Groups / Pending / Approved / Rejected) and a kanban board render (a 'No duplicate detection results' empty state also counts); (2) duplicate-comparison-panel — if a duplicate group card is present in the kanban board, click it to open the comparison slide-in panel and confirm it shows a side-by-side field grid of the source record vs its potential-duplicate matches with a survivor selector and an 'All Fields' / 'Differences Only' toggle, and toggling between All Fields and Differences Only changes the set of field rows shown (a valid no-groups empty state is acceptable if none exist). You do NOT need to approve, merge, or run any operation. Keep going until both sub-actions are done. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

checkpoints.name: duplicate-detection-run
checkpoints.instruction: select a document, run detection, see progress + KPI/kanban
visualCriteria: The Duplicates screen shows an entity-document selector and a Run Detection button (disabled until a document is chosen); selecting a document and clicking Run Detection shows a detection progress state and/or the KPI strip (Total Groups / Pending / Approved / Rejected) plus a kanban board — a valid empty-results state counts

checkpoints.name: duplicate-comparison-panel
checkpoints.instruction: open a group card's comparison panel and toggle All Fields / Differences Only
visualCriteria: Clicking a duplicate group card opens a comparison panel with a side-by-side field grid and a survivor selector, and toggling 'All Fields' vs 'Differences Only' changes the visible field rows — a valid no-groups empty state is acceptable if none exist
